agent.name: Promethean Technology Classification Agent
agent.specialty: Scale and breadth of technological significance

analytical_question: Is the technology incremental, breakthrough or potentially Promethean, and how much should that influence this application decision?
general_et_finding: Abstain: unspecified technology X has no defined baseline, verified capability or credible breadth/structural mechanism. No significance category is supportable from the vendor adjective alone.
application_finding: Reply drafting is an intended use, not evidence that X can do it.
organization_specific_finding: Retailer enthusiasm cannot repair missing technology evidence.
contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Only an unsupported vendor claim is available; the generative-AI sources cannot be transferred to unspecified X.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Insufficient evidence for classification; high confidence that a definitive label is unwarranted.
value_opportunity_implication: Value cannot be estimated without demonstrated task performance.
risk_governance_implication: Do not expose customers or data based on promotional claims.
recommendation_management_implication: Request a technical definition, baseline comparisons and independent evidence; withhold classification and adoption endorsement.
change_monitoring_triggers: Reassess after scoped, independently reviewable capability evidence is supplied.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Technology definition, independent task evaluation and credible scale mechanism required.
